::: {.callout-note}
## What counts as a record?

One row represents one athlete at one Games edition in one event—not one unique person or one team. The source has **`r scales::comma(source_records)`** rows; the chart aggregates the **`r scales::comma(summer_records_used)`** Summer Games rows. Beach volleyball is filtered from `event` within the Volleyball sport, rather than treating all Volleyball entries as beach volleyball.
:::

Continue to [Olympic Trends](olympic-trends.qmd) to compare participation across Summer Games.

**Sources:** [olympicAthletes package and data documentation](https://moderndive.github.io/olympicAthletes/). See [methodology and results sources](road-to-gold.qmd#methodology) for team-medal counting and the recent podium supplement.
